question: Can I cast Primal Might with X equal to 0 just to have my creature fight the other target creature?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: X can be 0 so the two creatures just fight.
expected.answer: You can cast Primal Might with 0 as the value of X to just have the two target creatures fight.
